name: Assembly Model
summary:
Assembly Model is a life-size mechanical engineering workshop inside your Meta Quest.
PARAMETRIC PARTS
Over 40 generators with standard sizes (ISO, DIN, ANSI): bolts, nuts, washers, gears, racks, sprockets and chains, pulleys, steel cables, winches, bearings, pillow blocks, couplings, shafts, aluminum extrusions, springs and motors. Type the size you need (for example M6 × 30) and the part is built instantly.
